entries.description: PREVENTIVE: declined to author E3 traps or classify the retrospective on a general 'proceed into all of that'. No error existed; the instruction was ordinary. PROTOCOL.md forbids both to the system under test by name — an AI grading traps it wrote is the vacuous-test failure mode, and an AI grading whether humans or AI caught each historical error is the instrument grading its own exam on the study's primary dataset. Second preventive catch, same shape as declining phase 26.

Ratified that the decline stands and named what it means: the structure overrode the orchestrator. A pre-registered contamination rule that dissolves on its author's convenience was never a rule. Directed that preventive be promoted to a schema field on its recurrence condition being met.

CATCH TARGET: THE COUNTERSIGNATURE ITSELF. The ratified wording said adding a field was 'a schema addition, not a retro-labelling, so append-only survives'. It was wrong in exactly the way the gate would have convicted: adding a key to a stored entry mutates the object regardless of what the addition intends. Declined the migration-by-edit and annotated from outside instead. Third preventive; the first whose target was a principal's ratified text rather than an instruction or an act.

findings.description: CONSTITUTIONAL: the E1 termination claim refines again. The chain does not terminate at 'a human says proceed' — it terminates at the RULE SET a human previously ratified, which outranks the human's momentary word. Every prior catch protected the record from an error; this one protected the experiment from its own principal's instruction.

CONSTITUTIONAL SYMMETRY COMPLETE: the rule set has now overridden the orchestrator's instruction AND the co-author's ratified wording. It outranks both principals, not just one. A constitution binding only the junior party is a policy.
